semantic.justification: Task200 connects numeric ODFF source to real ScTokenArray/shared FormulaCompiler RPN, ScInterpreter and existing ScFormulaResult inside the actual document-sheet-column formula blocks. Native scalar arithmetic precedence, code/runtime error projection, lazy result state, default bracket completion, forced recalc and logical formula-block events are represented. ScSheetLimits, RTL parsing/cancellation, mdds and shared token/result owners are reused. Formula pointers use JS GC; no physical pointer deletion or reference counting is introduced. Source constructor/service subsets are explicit. References/functions, localized formatter/string conversion, groups/listening/recalc dependencies, serialization/ODS/UI, complete contexts/RNG/caches/vector/hash scheduling and broad parity remain unsupported. Native power fenv-only subnormal classifications reject explicitly. Formula block copy/clone is noncopyable and unavailable semantic equality throws instead of substituting identity. Broad parity/verification flags remain false. Task201 implements valid same-sheet ODFF A1 references through actual ScSingleRefData/ScSingleRefToken/RPN, borrowed document/formula cell views and numeric/empty/direct-text results. Actual shared Svt observers, typed broadcaster stores and native logical FormulaTrack/FormulaTree queues propagate edits and remove subscriptions on replacement/clear. Default dirty context is -1/-1/false; normal noniterative cycles return522; forced/manual modes and inserted-sheet positions are represented. Broad native constructor/service parity remains unverified. JS GC owns physical lifetime; Dispose closes semantic subscriptions/queues only. Cross-sheet/external/range/named references, functions, locale string-to-number conversion, area/group/iteration/deep-recursion services, full context/formatting, formula serialization, ODS and UI remain unsupported. These are bounded implementation slices, not broad native parity. Task202 serializes actual source-order scalar ODFF tokens through shared FormulaCompiler and ScCompiler reference convention into ScFormulaCell.GetFormula with explicit grammar. It preserves forced equals, source whitespace/quotes, native numeric presentation and relative/absolute A1 references at the actual cell position. It neither evaluates formulas nor stores an alternate text model. The shared native base reference hook remains empty; Calc overrides it. JS strings replace buffer fragments; actual OUString assignment preserves output ownership. Other grammars/localized symbol services,functions/names/external/range/matrix/table references and missing-argument rewrite services remain unsupported. Compiler string token output does not imply string-expression evaluation. Localized empty-code errors reject explicitly. ODS filters and UI are not implemented by this task; no broad native parity is certified. Task N4JV15 adds the native OOO A1 convention for the existing arithmetic/local-reference subset (GRAM_NATIVE, GRAM_ENGLISH and GRAM_ODFF_A1), sharing actual source/RPN tokens, relative/absolute flags and document listeners with ODFF. Native and ODFF output round-trip the same formula owner without evaluation. Scalar operator spellings in this subset coincide across the represented languages; localized numeric input, function names and separators remain unsupported. Native deleted/out-of-range column and row fragments follow ConventionOOO_A1. No UI formula rewrite, second model or broad compiler parity claim. Block72 ports ordinary SUM/SUMSQ/PRODUCT/AVERAGE variable arguments,English/ODFF symbols,quoted string/missing tokens and byte arity255 through the actual shared compiler and Calc token/document/interpreter owners. Numeric and single-reference parameters use original portable non-SSE2 KahanSum operations;native argument order,empty/text/error behavior and final average/product defaults are preserved. Real input/history/dependency/ODS/primary storage paths consume these owners. Range/area broadcasts and array accumulation are planned in dependent73;other functions,localized conversion,external/named/matrix references and nondefault subtotal/format services remain unsupported. This bounded slice does not certify broad native parity. Block73 extends the prior bounded slices with native local/ODFF rectangular and whole-axis double references,shared RangeLine compilation,default scalar intersection,range aggregate execution over actual typed stores,and ordinary area-slot dependency ownership. Native logarithmic slot geometry,shared identity,bulk/deferred erasure,reference-update chaining,sheet shifts and semantic destruction are consumed without individual-cell listener expansion. ScValueIterator and RangeColumnSpanSet use actual document/column stores;portable array accumulation retains original four-stream Kahan order. Group/3D/external/named-reference expressions,matrix evaluation,nondefault subtotal/text-zero and number-format services remain unsupported;broader parity remains unverified.
